# Preface {.unnumbered}

This book teaches causal inference for practitioners who work with Python and real-world observational data.

It is organized around Pearl's Ladder of Causation — moving from association to intervention to counterfactual — with working Python code for every method.

## How to Use This Book

- **Part I** builds the conceptual foundation. Don't skip it.
- **Part II** covers the six core identification strategies. Each chapter stands alone.
- **Part III** connects causal inference to modern ML.
- **Part IV** puts it all together with case studies and a full pipeline.

## Computing Environment

All code uses Python 3.10+. To replicate:

```bash
conda create -n causal-inf python=3.10
conda activate causal-inf
pip install dowhy econml linearmodels pgmpy statsmodels networkx matplotlib plotly pandas numpy
```
